every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 maintains clear framing across frames 1-9, whereas Site 2 suffers from overlapping text on the 3D subject in frame 3 and an empty 3D background in frame 6.

explains_the_project.reason: Site 1 concretely visualizes log compression and retrieval via physical press and filing metaphors in frames 3-6, while Site 2 uses more abstract sci-fi machinery in frames 1-4.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Site 1 grounds its textured industrial workbench on a continuous floor grid across frames 1-9, whereas Site 2's metallic props float ungrounded in dark space in frames 5 and 7.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 1 anchors concise cards cleanly on the left in frames 1-9, avoiding the clipped cards and dense walls of text seen in Site 2's frames 3, 6, 8, and 9.

overall.reason: Site 1 better fulfills the request through cohesive scroll choreography, clear spatial layout, and an intuitive mechanical metaphor that directly illustrates how Straitjacket works.
